limitations: Only K_(2,m) with m>=3, one equal-priced exceptional length-two route, independent positive edge conductances, one edge deletion, and failed-edge endpoint resistance. A symmetric global minimizer and its unique symmetric ratio are proved; uniqueness of arbitrary asymmetric minimizers is not claimed. Independent external validation not performed.
provenance: Derived and checked against dated primary network-optimization literature; first source publicly posted 2010-04-13.
scientific_integrity: The exact unrestricted optimal value follows from convexity, finite-group symmetrization, and one-dimensional calculus; numerical tests supplement but do not establish the infinite-family theorem.
title: Sharp three-regime single-outage resistance allocation on two-hub networks
